content:
Apple raised the trade-in values for most of its product lines just last month, but following its "Surprise and Shine" event, it has updated them again — this time lowering iPhone trade-in values while raising those for iPad and most Macs. Here are the latest trade-in values.

Apple is now accepting the iPhone Air and iPhone 17 series for trade-in

Last month, Apple adjusted trade-in prices for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch models, Mac, and Android devices, with some devices seeing trade-in value increases of nearly 30%.

Today, Apple updated trade-in values once more, with the maximum trade-in amount for all iPhone models being reduced — some models by as much as $120.

On the other hand, trade-in values for the entire iPad lineup and all Mac models (except Mac Pro) have been raised, while trade-in prices for Apple Watch and Android devices have mostly been lowered or held flat.
